items: Surveys let you hear and fix guest concerns privately before they turn into public reviews, while also growing your customer database for loyalty programs and offers.
Structure your survey around one routing question for dine-in or delivery, an overall rating, category ratings for food, service, ambience and value, and an NPS question.
Add a drill-down that appears only when a category scores low, so unhappy guests can explain what went wrong with a comment or photo.
Tag responses by location, shift and channel, and end with a reward plus a review invitation for happy guests and a follow-up promise for detractors.
